==Description==
'''Rocking Chair''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 28 of the premium [[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Battle Pass]] track. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to interact with it, though sound effects can be heard while drinking hot chocolate. You cannot move while performing this emote.

It had a cost of {{PlushieSnowman|945}} or {{Robux|161}} ({{Robux|128}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale) to unlock, with a total cost of {{PlushieSnowman|12,105}} or {{Robux|2,722}} ({{Robux|2,166}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale).

==Trivia==
*'''Rocking Chair''' was modeled by [https://x.com/SoupedGun BlightedBush] and animated by STEALTH_NOVA.
**The model was made back in 2024.
**The mug held by the character has "''#1 Farmer''" on it. This references a type of player which farms but does little to nothing to actually defend the early waves, which was a frequent type of player to encounter back in 2020 - 2023.
***This ended up getting added to the emote to poke fun at them, as this type of player was something SoupedGun ran into a lot.
